$comment: What the RecordType extension of the guidelines adds to the schema of the guidelines: the RecordType, the format of data that a part of the system outputs and keeps in its store (s-7vm323mhry2enx3), written as a JSON Schema 2020-12 object.

schema.$comment: A RecordType is a rule of the section that declares it (s-ktfstpv8rurznrp), and is numbered among its rules; its title is the RecordType's name and its text what the RecordType is for (s-6eb92ddch7shuvu). The implementation's types and RuntimeChecks are generated from it and never written beside it (s-e877bnfa559tvk9). A RecordType that refines another RecordType is a RecordType variant of it where it holds answersTo (s-z3dnru6qqdf9m6j).

The format itself, as a JSON Schema 2020-12 object that the meta-schema of a RecordType's schema checks at any depth (s-j4t9vusnsajmqdw): each field a property, with its type, its bounds, whether its value is guaranteed (required) and what it means (description).

chosenBy.$comment: On a RecordType in which the values of some fields decide which other fields a data record holds: those fields, its own or inherited, that select its RecordType variant (s-z3dnru6qqdf9m6j).

answersTo.$comment: On a RecordType variant: the one value it corresponds to for each field that selects a variant of its RecordType (s-z3dnru6qqdf9m6j, s-c2r9jndrjbtbsv6).

identifiedBy.$comment: Where another RecordType refers to this one by an identifier: the field, its own or inherited, that identifies its data records (s-6eb92ddch7shuvu).

then.$comment: The top level of a RecordType variant's schema holds neither additionalProperties nor unevaluatedProperties (s-c2r9jndrjbtbsv6).

else.$comment: The top level of the schema of a RecordType other than a RecordType variant holds "type": "object" (s-qg2yqec2cgmcg2w).

fieldName.$comment: A field's name as the code spells it: an identifier in camelCase, so that the generated types use it unchanged.
